t_advice_summary_textbox.text: 6 different coloured gnomes but only two coloured baskets. Three gnomes correspond with each colour of basket. Need to figure out which three match which basket. Once a basket's value starts to decrease, switch to the other basket colour.

vb_textbox.text: The value of the gnomes corresponds with the multiplier and the colour of the basket. Three gnomes are a better choice for the x5 multiplier and three are better for the x1 multiplier.
